summary: Ansible-base 2.10 announced that Windows Server 2008 and 2008 R2 will no longer be supported or tested in the next release.
questions: Can I still manage Windows Server 2008 R2 hosts?
When does Ansible stop testing Windows 2008?

answer_card.title: Windows Server 2008/2008 R2 support ending
answer_card.answer_md: Windows **Server 2008 and 2008 R2** are not supported or tested from the release after ansible-base 2.10. Upgrade those hosts or pin an older Ansible for them.
